items.passiveText: Practice Makes Lethal On-Attack, gain Critical Strike Chance permanently up to 25%. Flurry On-Attacking an enemy champion, gain 30% Attack Speed for 6 seconds (30 second cooldown). Attacks reduce this cooldown by 1 second, increased to 2 seconds for Critical Strikes.

items.name: Zaz'Zak's Realmspike
items.passiveText: Void Explosion Dealing Ability damage to a champion causes an explosion that deals magic damage . Active (4 charges) Places an Invisible Stealth Ward that grants vision.

items.name: Zeke's Convergence
items.passiveText: Frostfire Tempest Casting your Ultimate summons a storm around you for 5 seconds. The storm deals 30 magic damage per second to enemy champions and Slows them by 30%.

items.name: Zhonya's Hourglass
items.passiveText: Time Stop Enter Stasis for 2.5 seconds.
